# Graphing in Excel {#sec-graphing-excel}

Excel builds a chart from a selection: highlight the numbers, choose a chart type, and it
draws one.  Getting a chart that is worth showing anyone takes a few more steps, and this
chapter walks through them.

## Learning Objectives {.unnumbered}

::: {.objectives}
By the end of this chapter, you will be able to:

- Build a bar, line and scatter chart from a range of cells
- Add and edit titles, axis labels and legends
- Adjust an axis, and know when changing its range misleads
- Save or copy a chart into a document
:::
